notes.title: 2025 Canadian Game Awards Nomination
notes.content:
[h1]2025 Canadian Game Awards[/h1]

[h2]Moving Houses Nominated in Multiple Categories[/h2]

Moving Houses has been nominated in two categories for the 2025 Canadian Game Awards!  First in Best Performance for Ben Burne's end credits song and second for Best Technology and Innovation! 

[url=2025 Canadian Game Awards Nominees]https://cgameawards.com/nominees[/url]

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.55
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese as a selectable language
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.53
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Custom Key bindings could break the tutorial screen when it tried to display a mouse button prompt if those keys had been rebound to something else.  Tutorial screen should now show mouse or keyboard keys properly and not break.

notes.title: Update 1.0.51
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] updated localization credits
[*] fixed an issue where invisible trigger box was blocking interaction with door

notes.title: Update 1.0.44

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.0.43
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some misplaced geometry as the house's floor was trying to escape under the walls and onto the lawn.  Told the house it needs to keep its floors inside the house.  The house grudgingly accepted.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879442/d0ef9b6dadf7997fc4f5ea116673fdf44e8bdfc9.png[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] A later game area has become more difficult to escape from.  Did the house make it harder to leave?  Or did you?
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.42
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased the lighting in a few rooms
[*] Made certain GRAVE collectables easier to collect
[*] Made a certain GRAVE set of doors close behind the player when collecting above collectables
[*] Added a Depth of Field toggle to the menu to disable the effect
[*] Fixed a bug where the menu buttons worked even when not visible
[*] Fixed a closet door bug
[*] Fixed a bug where resetting the tasks in the later game broke the task
[*] Fixed missing outside garage doors
[*] Fixed lamp and shark toy missing from a room
[*] Fixed an endgame hallway loading issue
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.41
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with duplicate front doors.  The front door should not misbehave anymore.  The front door has been told it needs to do better.  The [i]house[/i] is sorry.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.40
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed getting stuck in one of the bathtubs.  You can now jump out of it.
[*] Fixed being able to carry the basketball into the end credits.  You now drop the ball when getting into the van.
[/list]

notes.title: Steamdeck Compatibility:
notes.content:
[h1]Moving Houses was built with 
the Steam Deck in mind[/h1]

[list]
[*] It's fully gamepad compatible
[*] It's got onscreen glyphs that match the Steam Deck controls
[*] Large legible text
[*] It runs in the Steam Deck default resolution
[*] It runs smooth at the default settings
[*] It supports Steam Cloud saving
[/list]

If anyone runs into any issues playing on the Steam Deck, please report them!
